mainProblemPlain.headline: 1 uncaught JavaScript exception(s) detected
mainProblemPlain.explanation: The page's own code is throwing errors while people use it. Think of it like a machine that occasionally jams while running — it might still mostly work, but things can silently break, including the very tracking scripts meant to measure success.

checks.title: Potential duplicate GENERIC_ANALYTICS unknown
checks.description: 2 equivalent events were observed in rapid succession during the same interaction, which typically indicates the tag firing through more than one path (e.g. both a direct integration and Google Tag Manager).
checks.whyItMatters: Duplicate conversion events inflate reported conversions and corrupt ROAS/CPA calculations used to make budget decisions.
checks.recommendation: Check whether this tag is configured in both a native platform integration and GTM (or fired by two separate script instances), and de-duplicate.

checks.title: 1 uncaught JavaScript exception(s) detected
checks.description: One or more uncaught exceptions occurred during page load or interaction, which can break page functionality including tracking scripts.
checks.whyItMatters: Uncaught exceptions can silently prevent tracking tags, add-to-cart handlers, or other on-page scripts from running at all.
evidence: [pageerror] Failed to resolve module specifier "vendor". Relative references must start with either "/", "./", or "../". (t+9126ms)
checks.recommendation: Investigate and fix the uncaught exception(s) before sending paid traffic; re-run the audit afterward.

checks.title: 8 console error(s) logged during the session
checks.description: Multiple console errors were logged. Some may be benign (third-party script noise) but the volume warrants review.
checks.whyItMatters: Console error volume can be an early indicator of a fragile page, especially under real user network/device conditions.
evidence: [console.error] An import map is added after module script load was triggered. (t+4032ms)
[console.error] Multiple import maps are not yet supported. https://crbug.com/927119 (t+4517ms)
[console.error] Multiple import maps are not yet supported. https://crbug.com/927119 (t+4860ms)
checks.recommendation: Review console errors, particularly any originating from tracking or checkout-related scripts.

checks.title: 7 tracking-related network request(s) failed
checks.description: One or more requests to known analytics/ad-platform domains failed or were blocked.
checks.whyItMatters: Failed tracking requests directly translate into missing or undercounted conversion data.
checks.recommendation: Check for ad-blocker interference, CSP restrictions, or misconfigured tag endpoints.

checks.title: Slow full page load (10.9s)
checks.description: The page load event fired significantly later than the ~3-4s threshold generally considered acceptable for paid landing pages.
checks.whyItMatters: Slow-loading landing pages increase bounce rate and reduce ad platform quality/relevance scores.
checks.recommendation: Investigate render-blocking resources, large images, and third-party script load order.

checks.title: 19 resource(s) failed to load
checks.description: One or more page resources (images, scripts, styles) failed to load.
checks.whyItMatters: Broken resources can degrade visual polish and trust signals on the landing page.
checks.recommendation: Review the network failures list for specific broken resources.

checks.title: Consent banner not detected
checks.description: No consent banner could be detected via common selectors. This does not confirm one is absent — some implementations are custom-built.
checks.whyItMatters: This is a technical observation, not legal advice. Absence of a detectable banner does not confirm compliance status.
evidence: No element matching common consent-banner selectors was found.
checks.recommendation: If applicable regulations require a consent mechanism, confirm one exists and is technically implemented.
